correctness.rationale: Any tetra inside the convex hull has its absolute volume maximized at polytope vertices by successively maximizing a convex absolute-affine determinant in each chosen corner; thus 24 choose 4=10,626 vertex quadruples are exhaustive for the maximum. Inspected actual CHECK.py exact Z[sqrt2] pair arithmetic, SPECTRUM.csv and source RESULT.md; independently enumerated all 10,626 determinant values with a separate quadratic-integer determinant implementation: exactly 23 absolute levels, maximum 32+20sqrt2 with multiplicity 48. For every signed (±1,±1,±1) face normal, a triangle with support L+2 has two maximizing base triples whose three signed determinants agree, hence any apex in the face by affine interpolation is optimal; independent reconstruction yields 16 face/base families and their coverage of all 48 vertex-maximal tetrahedra. Orthogonal face pyramid areas give polytope volume (96+80sqrt2)/3 and exact occupancy (1+5sqrt2)/56. Explicitly does NOT claim classification of every nonvertex maximizer.
